# 現在賢劫千佛名經

**ID:** T0447a
**Volume:** T14
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 闕譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0447a

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Xiànzài xiánjié qiān fómíng jīng* is the "present aeon" counterpart to the past- and future-aeon thousand-Buddha-names texts ([KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0023) and [KR6i0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0026)–[KR6i0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0027)). It enumerates the thousand Buddhas of the present bhadrakalpa ("fortunate aeon"), the same cosmic period whose cosmological framework is elaborated in the *Xiánjié jīng* 賢劫經 ([KR6i0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0001)). Two recensions are preserved in the Taishō: T447a (this text) and T447b ([KR6i0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0025)). The anonymous translator and undated status are characteristic of the entire group.

**Abstract**

T447a (現在賢劫千佛名經, recension a) is the principal Taishō recension of the present-aeon thousand-Buddhas list and is supported by the major canon editions (Sòng, Yuán, Míng, Gōng, Koryŏ). The present-aeon list most directly corresponds to the *Xiánjié jīng* ([KR6i0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0001)) compiled by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù; together with the past-aeon and future-aeon lists, it forms the "three aeons, three thousand Buddhas" liturgical system used in the *Cíbēi sānmèi shuǐchàn* 慈悲三昧水懺 and other Chán and Tiāntái confession rituals. The thousand names in T447a may derive from or share material with chapter 20 (*Qiān fó mínghào pǐn* 千佛名號品) of the *Xiánjié jīng*, though their relationship is one of belonging to the same tradition rather than direct textual derivation.
